sections.text: On iPhone: Open Settings and select 'Wi-Fi', then switch Wi-Fi on. The phone automatically searches for nearby networks. Select the network you want. You may first need to enter its password or accept its terms and conditions. If you don't know the password, ask your network administrator. Check for a blue tick beside the network name and the Wi-Fi icon in the top corner of the screen. This confirms the connection. Optional: For a more reliable connection that uses cellular data alongside Wi-Fi, scroll down and turn on 'Connectivity Assist.'

On Android: Open the Settings app. Tap 'Network & internet', then 'Internet'. Tap a listed network. Networks with a lock icon require a password. If the network is nearby but not listed, wait for the list to refresh. If the network still isn't listed, scroll to the bottom and tap 'Add network'. Enter the network name (SSID) and security details, then tap 'Save'. Hidden network: Tap 'Advanced options', set 'Hidden Network' to 'Yes', then tap 'Save'.
